caption: The video captures an outdoor yard with a tall, curved, rust-streaked metal blade sculpture before a black picket fence, leafy trees, and a pale stone building casting a dappled wall shadow, plus a dark reddish sphere at the lower right. A pale cream sphere balanced on the blade's tip is already shedding pieces from its lower side as the clip opens. The shell breaks into a cloud of small tan and pinkish shards expanding outward and upward above the tip. As the pale layer disperses, a yellowish-green inner core is revealed, still perched on the blade where the sphere sat. The fragment cloud drifts and thins, some shards rising into the trees and others falling toward the fence. The blade, dark sphere, fence, and building stay fixed, indicating a stationary camera. Fragments remain mid-air in the last frame, showing a continuous breakup in progress.
relations: The pale sphere on the blade tip fragments into a cloud of tan and pinkish shards expanding outward and upward.
As the outer shell disperses, a yellowish-green inner core is revealed resting on the blade's tip.
The fragment cloud drifts and thins, with some shards rising toward the trees and others falling near the fence.
The blade, dark sphere, fence, and building remain fixed, indicating a stationary camera during the continuous breakup.
